correction.text: Esh Shaheinab "lies approximately 50 km north of Omdurman on the west bank of the Nile in central Sudan"; Early Khartoum and Khartoum Neolithic sites of the Khartoum area

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. A 100 km disc round Omdurman (113 land cells, about 29,000 km2) stands for the central Nile of Sudan; the page gives the Shaheinab site and its Sabaloka stone source (Sixth Cataract) but no area. The Early Khartoum span "8800 to 5000 BP" and the Neolithic "c. 5700-3550 BP, approximately 3750-1600 BC" overlap on the page; the Neolithic dates are used from 3750 BCE.

region.text: Esh Shaheinab "lies approximately 50 km north of Omdurman on the west bank of the Nile in central Sudan"; Early Khartoum and Khartoum Neolithic sites of the Khartoum area

ledger.note: 6000 BCE (project floor): Mesolithic fishers, hunters and gatherers of the Khartoum area. "Early Khartoum (8800 to 5000 BP)"; the Nubia page: "from the ninth to the sixth millennia cal BC, Khartoum Mesolithic fisher-hunter-gatherers" (second page). The culture begins before the floor; the Omdurman disc is the dossier's.

3750 BCE: the Khartoum Neolithic begins (Shaheinab). "Khartoum Neolithic (c. 5700-3550 BP, approximately 3750-1600 BC)"; the page also writes "5700-3500 BP - approximately 3700-3550 BC", a slip; cattle become "more abundant" as "hunter-fisher-gatherer societies transitioned to pastoralist communities".

region.text: Esh Shaheinab "lies approximately 50 km north of Omdurman on the west bank of the Nile in central Sudan"; Early Khartoum and Khartoum Neolithic sites of the Khartoum area

ledger.note: 1600 BCE: the Khartoum Neolithic ends. "Khartoum Neolithic (c. 5700-3550 BP, approximately 3750-1600 BC)"; the page names no successor, so the land passes to nobody (the Kerma culture of Nubia "from around 2500 BC", Nubia page, lies to the north).

certainty.note: Settlement sites along the Nile; no border is recorded.

sources.title: Shaheinab (Esh Shaheinab)
sources.note: Early Khartoum 8800-5000 BP; Khartoum Neolithic c. 5700-3550 BP (3750-1600 BC); Shaheinab 50 km north of Omdurman; Wavy Line pottery; cattle.

sources.title: Nubia
sources.note: Khartoum Mesolithic fisher-hunter-gatherers in the ninth to sixth millennia cal BC; Neolithic Nubia by 5000 BC; Kerma from around 2500 BC.

sources.title: Prehistory of Sudan
sources.note: Opened and not used for any event: does not name the Khartoum Mesolithic or Neolithic; says "By the eighth millennium BC, people of a Neolithic culture had settled into a sedentary way of life" in northern Sudan and "During the fifth millennium BC, migrations from the drying Sahara brought neolithic people into the Nile Valley".

notes: Khartoum Mesolithic and Neolithic, central Sudan. The pages titled Khartoum_Mesolithic and Khartoum_Neolithic do not exist (URL_NOT_FOUND); the Shaheinab site page and the Nubia page were used. identity.wikipedia is null for that reason. The Shaheinab page has internal slips (Early Khartoum "8800 to 5000 BP" overlaps the Neolithic from 5700 BP; "3700-3550 BC"). The A-Group (Lower Nubia) is the northern neighbour; the Sudanese Nile south of Khartoum and the Atbara are blank. Prehistory of Sudan page also opened (listed in sources): it names none of the Khartoum cultures but dates drying-Sahara migrations into the Nile Valley to the fifth millennium BC.
